description: PL.core-dock-operations-register. POST /api/v1/worlds/{worldId}/play-grants: mint the play grant a world's built game presents as x-insimul-play (World Browser's download, Godot). 201 PlayGrantIssued; the token is the game's, never logged or shown. requestCases: what a dock asks for (input: worldId, query parameters by name, a parsed JSON body) -> the request it must send (method, the expanded path, query, body: the JSON value to send or null for none), or the refusal (code, received) with no request at all. An absent body, null and {} all mean no body. row: the published openapi/operations.json row this file is about (method, path, pathParameters, queryParameters, auth, verdict) plus what a request may carry (body, bodyMembers) and whether contentWriteFindings admits it, with the reason; a test holds row to the stamped table and to the vendored contract. cases: no response cases yet (the docks' readers of these answers are the engines' own; none is in core). Reference: src/editor/dock-operations.ts dockOperationRequest, run by src/editor/__tests__/dock-operations.test.ts.

contentWrite.why: Admitted by decision (PL.core-dock-operations-register): a POST not named as a write and on no entity collection, and it writes no world content. It records a grant family (one play_grants document, no token stored) and answers a credential for the built game; its one body member is ttlSeconds. A body with any other member is refused (unknown-body-member), and one that is not an object (body-not-object).

source.note: method, path and auth as projected onto the mintPlayGrant row of openapi/operations.json; the requestBody schema (type object, ttlSeconds integer) from the contract; served per server SERVED_OPERATIONS at 75e91a5a
